roles.title: Three slow directions supply a carrier frame
roles.status: exact finite carrier result with its declared readout
roles.input: The twelve-port icosahedral carrier, uniform native seam repair and the record-recovered slow-band Gram.
roles.output: The smallest nonzero Laplacian band has rank3. The signed record/control Gram quotient completes to three-dimensional Euclidean coordinates.
roles.formula: lambda_slow=5-sqrt(5); G=4 P_slow; x(n)=sum_a n_a u_a; Delta x=j(u_b-u_a)
roles.intuition: A repair record says which seam carried a signed load. The slow directions turn those records into three coordinate components, up to a common rigid frame.
roles.not_implied: This local load coordinate is not automatically a particle detector or an inter-carrier 3+1-dimensional spacetime. In the protected one-per-site spin sector, total-load coordinates are scalar.
roles.diagram_spec: A twelve-point carrier fades into three coloured slow axes, then a recorded seam current becomes a three-component displacement arrow.

roles.title: The same field supplies position and translation momentum
roles.status: proved for the specified ordered-spin source, state and field domain
roles.input: One selected ordered-spin continuum, its spatial translations, field-vector map T and positive source Gram T* T.
roles.output: The polar map V=T(T* T)^(-1/2) transports the existing translation generator and a conjugate position onto the same field-response subspace.
roles.formula: X_i=V i partial_i V*; P_j=V hbar k_j V*; [X_i,P_j]=i hbar delta_ij I on V Schwartz; Delta X_i Delta P_i >= hbar/2
roles.intuition: Momentum measures how a field pattern changes its phase under translation. Localizing that pattern requires a spread of such phases and momenta.
roles.not_implied: The action unit hbar is declared, the vacuum has a retained no-position outcome, and this response space is not automatically an isolated Standard Model particle sector.
roles.diagram_spec: A wavepacket passes through a source-Gram normalizer into two linked rulers: location bins and translation-phase bins; retain a dark/no-position channel.

roles.title: Repair counts and modular flow are connected clocks, with a stated dictionary
roles.status: exact reconstructed reference family; physical clock matching is a separate premise
roles.input: The binary total-two source with uniform seam/coin law, complete-attempt transfer P, all no-movement attempts, and supplied closed-history length L.
roles.output: Native counts reconstruct H=-log P and rho_L=P^L/Tr(P^L). Their modular flows share H, with an exact reference-dependent parameter conversion.
roles.formula: sigma_s^L(A)=rho_L^(is) A rho_L^(-is)=P^(iLs) A P^(-iLs); conventional Heisenberg time tau=-Ls
roles.intuition: A repair counter counts events. A faithful reconstructed state defines an internal modular flow. The source theorem relates their statistical generator; a clock dictionary must identify what a detector calls elapsed time.
roles.not_implied: Native stochastic P is not its unitary analytic continuation. Modular parameter, repair count, weak-pulse time Nh, host runtime and physical duration are not interchangeable. A tracial state has trivial modular flow.
roles.diagram_spec: Parallel tracks labelled attempts n, reconstructed modular s, controlled pulses Nh and physical duration; connect n to H and rho, connect rho to s, use a dashed calibrated join to duration, never add the tracks.

roles.title: Complete effect weights have a Born representation
roles.status: finite theorem plus a native reconstructed-functional attachment
roles.input: Nonnegative normalized weights additive on every coexistent complex matrix-effect pair. For operational records: equal effects have equal probabilities and coexistent effects have disjoint common implementations.
roles.output: One unique density rho represents every effect weight as Tr(rho E). Complete native closed-history moments supply such a positive reconstructed functional.
roles.formula: p(r)=Tr(rho E_r), E_r=K_r* K_r, sum_r E_r=I; rho_r=K_r rho K_r*/p(r) for p(r)>0 in the chosen instrument
roles.intuition: The state and the detector effect determine each record weight. Comparing records makes the outcome shareable; it does not change those weights or make all incompatible properties sharp.
roles.not_implied: Born probabilities alone do not choose the state-update instrument. Bare definite-record effects are diagonal; a universal complex native detector bridge is an additional obligation.
roles.diagram_spec: A normalized tree of every detector record merges into the trace-weight formula; a separate pointer-update arrow follows the selected instrument, then two agreeing ledgers copy the record.

roles.title: Gauge theorems constrain the allowed interactions
roles.status: conditional Lie-type theorem; exact finite current and interaction constructions
roles.input: An injective commutator-closed twelve-port current response, positive trace pairing and internally implemented proper carrier rotations; a specified exterior matter module and gauge/Higgs action.
roles.output: The response Lie type is u(1)+su(2)+su(3). The fifteen-state matter image has one-family Standard Model weights. Actual finite gauge/Higgs vertices commute with the full local Gauss generators.
roles.formula: g = u(1) + su(2) + su(3); Lambda^2 V + Lambda^4 V -> Q,u^c,d^c,L,e^c; [G_x,V_x(Y)]=0
roles.intuition: Charge labels tell which field components can couple while preserving the record symmetry. The gauge algebra constrains the interaction grammar; an action and state determine its strength and response.
roles.not_implied: The number12 alone does not force a Lie algebra. One-family weights do not prove three propagating generations, source-selected couplings, a Higgs vacuum or an interacting chiral continuum.
roles.diagram_spec: The carrier response splits into one Abelian, three weak and eight colour current directions; arrows to a matter vertex close under a local charge-balance loop.
